About these names

Gnome names are playful and machine-adjacent — clattering consonant clusters (zz, ck, gl, sp) that sound like small moving parts. The register is deliberately comic: gnomes in most settings are tinkers and illusionists, and their names carry that whirring, slightly absurd energy.
